basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Research Assistant/ Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of History, University of Delhi needs one Research Assistant/ Field Investigator for the research project "Climate as a Historical Agent", funded by the Institution of Eminence (IoE), University of Delhi under its Faculty Research Programme (FRP) grant. The post is for three months from the date of appointment at a monthly remuneration of Rs. 20,000 (as per IoE norms), and the essential qualification is an MA in History. Candidates send a single PDF of relevant documents and a recent CV to [email protected] by 10 November 2026; the interview is on 16 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: 16 November 2026 (Exact Time will be emailed once shortlisted)

how_to_apply: Applications are made by email only. The notice gives no application form.
Combine the CV and your relevant documents into a single PDF, as the notice requires.
Make sure the email is sent by 10 November 2026, the last date for submission of CV.
The notice does not prescribe a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: About DU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The University of Delhi is a university in Delhi, and this research position is offered in its Department of History. The post serves the project "Climate as a Historical Agent", which is funded by the Institution of Eminence (IoE), University of Delhi under the Faculty Research Programme Grant. The Principal Investigator is Prof. Vipul Singh, Professor of Early Modern and Environmental History, Department of History, University of Delhi. The notice is dated 03 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: MA in History. Desirable requirements (as printed in the notice): Specialisation in Medieval/ Modern Indian History Experience of Handling Archival Sources Familiarity with Environmental History These are desirable requirements, not essential conditions. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant/ Field Investigator receives a monthly remuneration of Rs. 20,000, fixed as per IoE norms. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance. Tenure: three months from the date of appointment. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Continuation of the position will be dependent on availability of continued funding by IOE.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made by email only. The notice gives no application form. Prepare a recent CV. Combine the CV and your relevant documents into a single PDF, as the notice requires. Email the PDF to [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent by 10 November 2026, the last date for submission of CV. The notice does not prescribe a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants who are shortlisted will be called for an interview on 16 November 2026 . The exact time will be emailed once shortlisted. The interview mode is Offline/Online; for the online mode, the Google Meet link will be emailed to shortlisted applicants. Mere fulfilment of minimum qualifications does not guarantee selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DU Recruitment 2026 for Research Assistant/ Field Investigator?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, shown as 01 (Total), for the post of Research Assistant/ Field Investigator in the Department of History, University of Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DU Research Assistant/ Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of CV is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the DU Research Assistant/ Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an MA in History. Specialisation in Medieval/ Modern Indian History, experience of handling archival sources and familiarity with environmental history are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the DU Research Assistant/ Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 20,000, as per IoE norms.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the DU Research Assistant/ Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Send a single PDF of relevant documents and a recent CV by email to [email protected] by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this DU research position?
faq.answer: Shortlisted applicants will be interviewed on 16 November 2026, offline or online through Google Meet, with the exact time and link emailed to them.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DU Research Assistant/ Field Investigator post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, with a tenure of three months from the date of appointment, and continuation depends on availability of continued funding by IOE.

faq.question: Q8. Which project is the DU Research Assistant/ Field Investigator post for?
faq.answer: The post is for the project "Climate as a Historical Agent", funded by the IoE, University of Delhi under the Faculty Research Programme Grant, with Prof. Vipul Singh as Principal Investigator.
